Risto Pakkanen DISCOVERY CONFIRMED
SpaHotel Hamina (old hotel)
Breakfast at the SpaHotel
Getting thereSibeliuskatu 32, 49400 Hamina, Finland  ·  open in Maps
From Hotelli Jokipuisto — crew11.3 mi · 17 minFrom SpaHotel Hamina0.0 mi · 0 min
For Nick & the crewA Hamina lifer in his 60s who has survived three economic eras and says plainly that Google's construction phases are why his hotel is still open. To shoot: a working spa with guests and staff, and a boat moored beside the hotel that seats ten, which is the only way to get the campus from the water. Prefers Finnish. Parking at the hotel and at his house. Filming is booked separately for Mon 17.
Prep — background and 2 priority questions
Owner, SpaHotel Hamina. 60s, born and bred. His career mirrors Finland's swings — family jewellery business bought out of a 1990s bankruptcy, first in Finland to sell jewellery online, store closed 2022. Founded the hotel 2002; Russian tourism collapsed after 2014 and again in 2022 with the border. He credits Google's construction phases with the hotel surviving.
Entry pointOpen on the town before the campus and let him walk it forward through his own books. Do not open on Google.
Priority questions
  • Which construction phases filled the rooms, in which years, and roughly what share of occupancyYears and numbers, not adjectives.
  • Who in Kotka, and who does the campus touch that we'd never think ofHe recommended Ville Meronen originally; he will have more.
Scheduling detail
CONFIRMED in writing 7 Aug: “August 12th at 9am fits me well.” Sapir's invite is now issued to him directly (not a HOLD) at 9:00–9:30 Finland, venue the hotel. He asks how many people are coming — answer owed, he says next week is fine. Only the half hour has been asked for so far. CREW 11 Aug PM: Kimmo collects Jeff from the hotel at 8:00 and both meet the team at the SpaHotel at 8:30, half an hour before Risto sits down.
